steps: Sign in to the Supabase dashboard; this is Account > Access Tokens
Name it and give it only the permissions it needs
Click 'Generate token' and copy it - it is shown exactly once
This is a personal Management API token - not a project's publishable/secret or legacy anon/service_role key

limited.meaning: the token is valid but lacks the projects-read permission the check needs; it will do what you gave it

least_privilege.summary: Scope the token to the permissions you need instead of full access.
